name: queue
title: A bounded queue for many producers and consumers
summary: Producers enqueue numbered items and consumers dequeue them through a ring of slots, built up in three steps: a ring for one of each, positions claimed by compare-and-swap, and a sequence number per slot. The page checks every item arrived once and in its producer's order.

controls.name: step
controls.label: Design
controls.hint: one-to-one ring: plain head and tail, correct only for one producer and one consumer. claimed positions: compare-and-swap on the head and tail. sequenced slots: a sequence number per slot says whose turn it is.

results.name: unwritten
results.label: Unwritten slots
results.what: dequeues that found a slot its producer had not filled

results.name: disordered
results.label: Out of order
results.what: items a consumer saw before an earlier item of the same producer

results.name: duplicated
results.label: Seen twice
results.what: items that arrived at a consumer twice

results.name: dropped
results.label: Dropped
results.what: items a producer gave up on after the queue stayed full

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing
